snippet.title: I Hate This Place - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
I Hate This Place is OUT NOW on PC and CONSOLES!

Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604490/I_Hate_This_Place/
PlayStation - https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017830/
Switch - https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/i-hate-this-place-switch/
Xbox - https://www.xbox.com/games/store/i-hate-this-place/9p9n7vg2bf53

A craft-based, isometric survival horror game with twisted monsters and warped reality. Scavenge and build to survive terrifying days and nights while using stealth and noise to fight enemies that stalk by sound. All styled with bold comic art and an '80s horror vibe.
